data.gender_notes: Ambrosina is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word ‘ambrosia’, meaning ‘immortal’ or ‘everlasting’. In Christian tradition, Ambrosina is the feminine variation of Ambrose, a saint and bishop known for his wisdom and eloquence. The name Ambrosina carries the meaning “Immortal, Everlasting” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Ambrosina usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, everlasting and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the eternal and unchanging nature of God's love.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ambrosina total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
